_note: AUTHORED. fallback, nesting, a11y, responsive, capabilities and tokenRoles are owner decisions of 2026-10-23 (DEC-080); a11y and responsive state only what the source does. tokenRoles maps the private --_ vars Alert themes through (no component-token layer) to the tokens they resolve to in Alert.module.css: --_pad per size, --_accent per variant (roadmap Phase 2d).

hiddenProps.className: Styling escape hatch; the protocol carries no CSS.
hiddenProps.children: An alias of description in Alert.tsx; Figma draws only the description, so the protocol uses description.
hiddenProps.icon: Figma draws the intent icon per variant with no instance swap; the protocol picks it through variant (or hideIcon).

a11y.role: role=status (polite) for info, success and neutral; role=alert (assertive) for warning and danger.
a11y.dismiss: The dismiss button is labelled "Dismiss <variant> alert"; the icon is aria-hidden.
